rules.accepted_credit_types: Activity types, credit values, caps and documentation are listed in the table of 20 CSR 2205-5.010(5).
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed during a renewal cycle: prorated (months licensed ÷ months in the cycle × 24, rounded to the nearest whole number).
rules.audit_note: Verify completion on the renewal form (no verification = no renewal; falsification may lead to discipline). Keep documentation 2 years after renewal; licensees are subject to audit (20 CSR 2205-3).
rules.notes: Conversion per the rule: 1 CCC = 1 contact hour = 50 minutes; 1 CEU = 10 CCCs; 1 academic credit hour = 10 CCCs. Licenses renew biennially; the rule's example shows a 24-month reporting cycle ending June 30 of an odd year.
rules.rule_quote: (1) At the time of license renewal, the licensee shall verify completion of twenty-four (24) Continuing Competency Credits (CCC) on the renewal form.
